about: IBITI Agent Arena crowd impostors. uv = [u0, v0, u1, v1] in three.js texture space (v up, flipY). size = [w, h] in metres of a vertical billboard (h already divided by cos(elev)). anchor = [x, y] share of the cell from its lower left: the floor under the hips. torch = [x, y] share of the cell where a phone torch flashes. Same layout in the lite files.
